reason: I already own a few paid mind-reading apps, and 99 ₪ one time is nothing for me. A Hebrew version that puts the word in the Photos gallery, the calculator or a fake call fills a real gap in my kit, but I'd only pay after the free tricks fool my own family.
objection: A browser-installed web app has to look exactly like the real Photos gallery or calculator. If anything looks off, a sharp friend will spot it, and then it's just one more gimmick that sits unused in my collection.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks look fake or laggy next to the paid apps I already use, I won't buy.
